data.name: Aftab
data.gender_notes: Aftab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aftab is a name that symbolizes light and radiance. It is often associated with the sun and its life-giving properties. The name Aftab carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aftab usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Aftab is reminiscent of Allah's attribute as the 'Light of the Heavens and the Earth' (Quran 24:35).
data.etymology: Aftab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aftab total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أفتاب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفضاء و يعني الشمس أو ضياء الشمس
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أفتاب مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ف-ت-ب و هو يعني الانبساط و الانتشار في الفضاء، و في اللغة العربية يعني الشمس أو ضياء الشمس، و يرمز إلى الإشعاع و النور.

in_urdu.name: افتاب
in_urdu.meaning: شمس یا سورج کی روشنی، مشرق کی تابناکی
in_urdu.long_meaning: افتاب ایک فارسی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے شمس یا سورج کی روشنی، یہ نام مشرق کی تابناکی اور روشنی کی علامت ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا استعمال شمس کی مانند ایک روشن اور تابناک شخصیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अफ्ताब
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफ्ताब नाम का अर्थ है सूर्य की रोशनी या सौर प्रकाश, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में सूर्य की तरह एक उज्ज्वल और प्रबुद्ध व्यक्तित्व की ओर संकेत करता है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है.

in_pashto.name: افتاب
in_pashto.meaning: لمر یا د لمر رڼا، د سهار روښانتیا
in_pashto.long_meaning: افتاب په پښتو کې معنی لري لمر یا د لمر رڼا، دا نوم د سهار روښانتیا او د لمر د څرنګوالي څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او دا په افغان او پښتون قومونو کې د کارولو لپاره یو مشهور نوم دی.

in_english.name: Aftab
in_english.long_meaning: Aftab is derived from the Arabic root 'f-t-b' which means to spread out or to expand, and it signifies sunlight, brightness, or radiant. In Islamic tradition, Aftab symbolizes illumination, guidance, and spiritual enlightenment. The name Aftab has historical significance in various Muslim cultures and is often associated with positive personality traits such as warmth, optimism, and charisma.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name "Aftab" holds an essential place in various aspects of daily life and traditions. One primary connection is its significance during the month of Ramadan. The sighting of the new moon heralds the start of this holiest of Islamic months. The name "Aftab" embodies the spirit of renewal and hope as a new month of fasting begins with the sunrise, which is also metaphorically known as "Aftab-e-R norma" or "the sun of mercy."
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Aftab" is steeped in spiritual significance as it is often linked to light and enlightenment. In the Sufi tradition, it is said that the realization of light within a seeker's soul forms the foundation of their spiritual journey. The constant, continual presence of "Aftab" within the self is a reminder of Divine guidance in one's spiritual journey. Furthermore, recognizing the innate Divine light within oneself can lead to a state of spiritual enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Radiant, Shining" symbolizes Aftab is a name that symbolizes light and radiance. It is often associated with the sun and its life-giving properties.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aftab serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of radiant, shining.
